yeah. they gave it to someone i trained. i just feel like im not good enough. never will be

worth i guess. idk. honestly whats even the point. im so tired of all of it

blank mostly. dunno. gonna go lie down. thanks tho
Blank mostly, and then needing to lie down. I’ll leave it there, and thank you for letting me in.
